lines.text: What to write down, gather and bring the day before a doctor visit, and where to keep the notes after it.
A paperwork list, not medical advice.

head.text: Write the reason, then your questions in order.

body.text: Write what has changed, with dates.

head.text: List every medicine, vitamin and supplement from the labels.

body.text: Put the bottles in the bag.

head.text: Add photo ID and your insurance card.

body.text: If someone is coming with you, tell them the top question.

head.text: Tell the desk or the nurse you have questions, so the time can be planned around them.
Start with your most important question.

body.text: Take notes, or let the person with you take them.

line.text: A Visit page for that person: your questions with a box to tick each, what is taken now, recent symptoms, and room for notes.
